RefusalCode.description: The stable name of a refusal, `<surface>.<reason>` in lower case, such as `experiment.path_overlap`.

Side.description:
Whose input a refusal blames.

This is not the `Side` of the evaluator protocol (`evaluation::Side`), which names the end of a
connection, the core or the plug-in, that has to be upgraded.

oneOf.description: A plug-in: its manifest, its answers to the protocol or its environment.
Candler's configuration, its settings or a value it holds for the author.
The machine, the container runtime or what the run needs from outside.
Candler itself: the error is not the author's.

description: One refusal as a caller that parses stderr reads it: a document with the version marker `refusal/1` in `schema`, the stable `code`, the `side` at fault, the `path` into the parsed document or the `file`, never both, the `message` and the `causes` that explain it.

causes.description: The messages of the errors that caused this one, outermost first; empty when there are none.

code.description: The stable code of the refusal.

file.description: The file the refusal is about, when it is not about a place in a parsed document.

message.description: The error's message, as the text form of the CLI prints it.

path.description: The RFC 6901 JSON pointer of the place in the parsed document where the error sits; empty for the root. Absent when the refusal names a file or nothing.

schema.description: The version marker of the document: always `refusal/1`.

title: RefusalRecord
